title: Communication Within Firms: Evidence from CEO Turnovers
eligible_reason: Not a difference-in-differences design: all 102 firms experience a CEO turnover (September-December 2018) and every regression is reghdfe Y ib2.period, abs(companynumber) cluster(companynumber), i.e., log communication on bi-monthly relative-time dummies (period 0-9, base period 2 = the two months before the transition) with firm fixed effects only. There is no calendar-time fixed effect and no untreated comparison group, so the TWFE/CSA/BJS comparison cannot be formed. Heterogeneity figures interact the period dummies with time-invariant firm groups (hq_group, high_tmt_turn, high_board_turn, internal). The shipped data are explicitly fake.
design_notes: Firm by bi-monthly period panel (102 firms, 725 observations in the real data; 22 months of email metadata and 17 months of meeting metadata, 2018-2019). Outcomes: log meeting count, duration, attendees, log email counts, same/different department meeting counts and ratio, vertical/horizontal meeting counts (Tables 2-3; Figures 1-3 plot the period coefficients). Figures 4-5: ib2.period##group interactions with margins. The README notes a staggered adoption of email services (firms enter the data from January 2018) but this is not used as treatment.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: CEO changes occur within four calendar months (Sept-Dec 2018), so at most a few bi-monthly cohorts, but calendar time is not modelled and all firms are treated.

specs.exclusion_reason: relative-time dummies with firm FE only; no calendar-time FE; no untreated units
specs.outcome: lm_n lm_dur lm_att le_i_n le_i_rec (logs of meeting count, duration, attendees, emails sent, emails received)
specs.treatment_definition: bi-monthly period relative to CEO transition (0-9; base 2)
specs.data_file: dta files/comm_firmlevel_fake.dta (synthetic; real file comm_firmlevel.dta not shipped)

data_files_note: README: 'these 5 dta files contain fake data for a fake company with the same fields represented as in the real data. We cannot directly share our email provider's proprietary data.' Access only via signed agreement with the email provider.
priority_note: Not eligible (no calendar-time FE, no comparison group) and data synthetic.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Sun-Abraham/Borusyak flags come from text citations; no such estimators appear in the code.
